SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKOLO0001C001','KRKOLO0002C001','KRKOLO0003C001') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05 ','RE06 ')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT decode(rq02.use_chk,'N','D','C') as status, to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD') as ADD_DATE, to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') as ADD_TIME, nvl(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO ,' ') as QUOTATION_NO, nvl(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ ,' ') as QUOTATION_SEQ, nvl(RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_RND , 0) as REVISION_NO, nvl(RQ02.GDS_CD ,' ') as BUYER_ITEM_NO, nvl(RQ02.GDS_NM ,' ') as DESCRIPTION, nvl(RQ02.STND_NM ,' ') as SPECFICATION, nvl(RQ02.UNIT_CD ,' ') as UNIT_MEASURE, nvl(RQ03.SLS_UNTPRC , 0 ) as UNIT_PRICE, nvl(RQ02.NOTE ,' ') as SEND_REMARK FROM KEPCON.KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ04 RQ04, KEPCON.KEPMPRQ03 RQ03 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05','RE06') AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RE_NO AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_SEQ AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RE_RND AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_NO = RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_NO AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_SEQ AND RQ03.QUOTA_RQ_RND= RQ04.QUOTA_RQ_RND AND RQ04.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ03.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND RQ03.SUBID_CHK = 'Y'
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 RQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Z', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 RQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND = $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
